scope: Independent artifact/hash/settings/placement/deposition checks; 27 measured cases are not a universal accuracy bound. The three oblique slicer failures retain their inputs and diagnostic logs; their cause is not established by the generic CLI error.

added_assumptions: Additional raster-scale anisotropy, local voids, bonding defects and moisture are not modelled.
Estimated filament covers the part only; supports, adhesion and purge are excluded. Check usage and orientation trends in your slicer.
Print orientation defines the material frame; it does not check bed contact, overhangs or whether the part can be printed in that orientation.
Layer contours use nominal line width and layer height; bead overlap, variable extrusion widths, gap fill and toolpaths are not modeled.

affected_tests: 16 passed, with two existing dependency deprecation warnings.

orientation_source_note.observation: CLI initializes allow_rotations to true. The new matrix disables arrange/orient and verifies saved placement; no conclusion about the generic oblique failure is drawn from this source.
